subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & reschedule (tight confirm)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@acmeai.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up + next steps (demo)

Hi Sam/Taylor —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Your team is evaluating ways to reduce inference costs and get predictable latency for customer-facing features (chat and summarization).
- Primary requirements: VPC/private deploy option, 99th pct latency under 150ms for short prompts, and an SLA for peak periods.
- Key success metric: 30% reduction in per-token serving cost while keeping quality parity.

Next steps I suggested on the call: schedule a 45-minute technical demo + infra deep-dive with your engineering lead so we can walk through architecture, routing/fallback options, and quantization recommendations. Rafael (cc'd) will join for runtime/ops questions.

I have the following slots this week — can you confirm the best one (I’ll book and send calendar invite):
- Tue 12/1 10:00–10:45am PT
- Tue 12/1 3:00–3:45pm PT
- Wed 12/2 11:00–11:45am PT

If none of those work, share two windows that do and I’ll prioritize. To make scheduling easier, here’s my calendar link: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/demo-30m

Thanks — looking forward to diving in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

--

Hi Marissa —

Sorry — we had an internal scheduling conflict and I missed the end of the call. Appreciate the recap.

The proposed times look good in general, but Tuesday afternoon is tricky for our infra team. Would it be possible to move to Thursday morning (12/3) or Friday morning (12/4)? If not, Wed 11:00am PT should work.

Also, can Rafael cover our questions around private deployment options and KMS integration?

Thanks,
Sam

Thanks for the note, Sam — no problem on the timing. Rafael will absolutely cover private deployment/KMS questions.

We try to keep these scheduling confirmations tight so we don't get tripped up again. Can you confirm one of the following and I’ll send the invite immediately (I’ll also add a short agenda and pre-reads):

- Thu 12/3 9:00–9:45am PT (preferred)
- Thu 12/3 10:30–11:15am PT
- Fri 12/4 9:30–10:15am PT

If you want me to hold any of these, reply with the exact slot and I’ll lock it — otherwise I’ll release them by EOD today. Rafael, feel free to add any tech items you want us to cover.

Agenda (brief):
1) Architecture & routing (10m)
2) Private deployment + KMS/keys (15m)
3) Latency/cost tradeoffs + quantization (15m)
4) Q&A & next steps (5m)

Thanks — Marissa
